name: env-cap-example-nextjs
description: A minimal Next.js todo app demonstrating a real NEXT_PUBLIC_* (client) vs. server-only environment variable boundary, enforced by env-cap's contract mechanism at next.config.ts load time -- before any client bundle compiles.

scripts.docs: env-cap --include "src/features/**/env.*.schema.ts" --location src/generated/env.manifest.ts --docs docs/ENVIRONMENT.md --env-example .env.example --env-example-on-existing overwrite --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --evidence docs/env.evidence.json
scripts.build: npm run docs:alignment && tsx scripts/validate-env.ts && next build
